## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Stream run command output (tools, ~12h, HIGH)

- **What**: Cline #13179 "feat(desktop): stream run command output" (merged 2026-08-19). Adds real-time streaming of bash/shell command output (live detached command logs, PID-reuse defense via command-log identity matching, probe-outage retention, leftover merge conflict fix in messages projection test). Pattern: bash tool yields output incrementally as process writes to stdout/stderr, TUI renders streaming output in real-time (incremental text append to ToolRow command output), detached command logs survive probe failures and hub restarts, PID-reuse defense retains logs only for commands still running (not reused PIDs), reconcile command output tool rows on desktop. Infrastructure: command-log persistence layer, live output streaming via SDK coordinator, TUI streaming render (append mode for stdout/stderr blocks), abort signal cleanup (reap detached logs after hub restarts). User benefit: immediate feedback for long-running commands (npm install, tests, builds), progress bars and spinners render live, no waiting for full command exit to see output.
- **Why**: Alexi bash tool (`src/tool/tools/bash.ts`) buffers stdout until process exit (L365-456: `proc.stdout.on('data', ...)` accumulates into local `stdout += stdoutDecoder.write(data)`, only returned when `proc.on('close', ...)` fires). TUI shows a spinner while running (ToolRow.tsx L147) but NO incremental output. Cline's #13179 adds real-time streaming of command output — immediate feedback for long-running commands (npm install, test suites, build scripts), progress bars/spinners render live, users see failures immediately instead of waiting for full command exit. HIGH priority: high-value UX improvement (instant feedback for npm/build/test commands is critical for developer flow), proven pattern (Cline production), medium complexity (~12h: add incremental yield in bash.ts via callback or async generator, update TUI ToolRow to append streaming text chunks, add log retention for detached commands, PID-reuse defense via command-log identity matching, probe-outage retention, abort signal cleanup). Pattern portable (streaming orchestrator exists in `streamingOrchestrator.ts` for LLM responses, extend to tool output). HIGH priority: high-impact UX improvement for CLI tool where command execution is primary interaction.
- **Source**: Cline PR #13179 "feat(desktop): stream run command output" (merged 2026-08-19). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13179. Adds live detached command logs, PID-reuse defense, probe-outage retention, reconcile command output tool rows.
- **Category**: tools (bash command streaming). **Size**: ~12h (add incremental yield callback or async generator in bash.ts, update TUI ToolRow for streaming text append, add command-log persistence layer, PID-reuse defense, probe-outage retention, abort signal cleanup, test with long-running commands). **Priority**: HIGH (high-impact UX improvement, immediate feedback for npm/build/test commands, proven pattern, medium complexity). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-19).

#### 2. Structured command form `{ command, args? }` for direct exec (tools, ~6h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13336 "fix: run_commands object form without args routes through the shell" (merged 2026-08-19). Adds structured `{ command, args? }` object form for run_commands tool. Direct exec (spawn without shell) only applies when a non-empty args array is provided; object form without args key is routed through shell like the string form (e.g. `{ command: "echo hello" }` without args → shell execution, not ENOENT failure). Schema descriptions tightened so models put arguments in args instead of embedding them in command. Pattern: union schema `string | { command: string, args?: string[] }`, spawn branch selection (args key present AND non-empty → direct exec with shell:false, otherwise → shell execution via getShellInvocation), structured input contract (explicit empty args array `[]` is intentional direct exec, no args key is shell command line). User benefit: models can request direct execution for security/control (avoid shell injection, preserve argument boundaries, predictable quoting), shell execution for complex pipelines/redirection/glob expansion.
- **Why**: Alexi bash tool (`src/tool/tools/bash.ts`) only supports string command (L200: `command: z.string().describe('The command to execute')`), always routed through detected shell (bash/zsh/fish/powershell/cmd) via `spawn(shellFile, [...shellPrefix, params.command], ...)` (L340-370). Cline's #13336 adds structured `{ command, args? }` form for direct execution without shell (security, argument boundary preservation, predictable quoting) while preserving shell fallback for complex command lines (pipelines, redirection, glob expansion). MODERATE priority: security improvement (direct exec avoids shell injection for known command + args lists), model flexibility (structured tool calls for npm/git/docker commands with known args), medium complexity (~6h: update BashParamsSchema to union `z.string() | z.object({ command, args? })`, add spawn branch selection logic based on args key presence, update schema descriptions, test direct exec vs shell execution paths). Pattern portable (bash tool schema + spawn call).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13336 "fix: run_commands object form without args routes through the shell" (merged 2026-08-19). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13336. Fixes ENOENT for `{ command: "echo hello" }` without args by routing to shell. Guards: args key presence (not array length) gates direct exec.
- **Category**: tools (bash command structured form). **Size**: ~6h (update BashParamsSchema to union string | object, add spawn branch selection logic, test direct exec + shell fallback paths, update schema descriptions). **Priority**: MODERATE (security improvement, model flexibility, medium complexity, proven pattern). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-19).

#### 3. Collapse finished runs into work summary (tools/tui, ~8h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13315 "feat(ui/desktop): collapse finished runs into a work summary and remove hover-state dead space" (merged 2026-08-19). Adds WorkActivity component that folds a finished agent run's working rows (tool calls, thinking traces, narration) behind a single expandable disclosure with label "Worked for 4m 12s and made 14 tool calls" (duration + tool-call-count), tight working-row rhythm (0.25rem gap instead of 1rem transcript gap), floating hover-pill actions (self-backed pill over following content, no reserved blank space), 180ms iOS-style disclosure easing. Pattern: run boundary detection (delimited by user messages, trailing run only collapses when session stopped AND produced assistant answer), collapseCompletedWork post-processes grouped transcript (working rows fold into WorkActivity row while final answer stays visible), assistant messages with images/media treated as deliverables (never collapse), cancelled/failed/error tails keep rows expanded regardless of partial text. User benefit: completed runs collapse into one-line summary, conversations stay scannable with tight spacing, final answers prominent, working details available on demand.
- **Why**: Alexi TUI has AnimatedDisclosure component (`src/cli/tui/components/AnimatedDisclosure.tsx` L1-175: height easing between 0 and contentLines over 120ms, per-row animation, inert contract, rapid-toggle handling) + ToolRow expand/collapse (`src/cli/tui/components/ToolRow.tsx` supports isExpanded state, individual tool disclosure) but NO high-level run grouping or work summary. Cline's #13315 adds WorkActivity component that groups multiple tool calls + thinking traces into one collapsible "Worked for 4m 12s and made 14 tool calls" summary — conversations stay scannable, completed work collapses by default, final answers prominent. MODERATE priority: UX polish for long sessions (multi-turn agent runs produce dozens of tool calls, collapsing into summaries keeps transcript readable), medium complexity (~8h: add run boundary detection logic, WorkActivity summary component with duration + tool-call-count label formatting, collapsed transcript projection, integrate with existing AnimatedDisclosure, test run delimitation + collapse gating + partial-text handling). Pattern portable (AnimatedDisclosure already exists, WorkActivity is pure React component).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13315 "feat(ui/desktop): collapse finished runs into a work summary" (merged 2026-08-19). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13315. Adds WorkActivity component, collapseCompletedWork transcript projection, floating hover-pill actions, 180ms disclosure easing. Guards: trailing run only collapses when session stopped AND answer produced.
- **Category**: tools/tui (run grouping + work summary). **Size**: ~8h (add run boundary detection, WorkActivity component with label formatting, collapsed transcript projection, integrate AnimatedDisclosure, test collapse gating). **Priority**: MODERATE (UX polish for long sessions, medium complexity, proven pattern, AnimatedDisclosure already exists). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-19).

#### 4. Native OS notifications (tools/config, ~6h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13166 "feat(desktop): native notifications" (merged 2026-08-19). Adds OS-level native notifications (macOS target, desktop app identity isolation for dev builds). Pattern: native notification API integration (Tauri's notification module for desktop, node-notifier or similar for CLI), notification permission gating, task-completion triggers (agent run finished, tool execution failed, long-running command completed), notification content (task summary, status, session link). User benefit: immediate awareness when agent finishes long-running task (no need to watch terminal/window), desktop notification center integration (macOS/Windows/Linux notification APIs).
- **Why**: Alexi has NO native notification system (grep for "notification|notify|Notification" only found MCP protocol `list_changed` notifications, internal bash detach event notifications, agent switch formatting utilities; no node-notifier, no native bindings, no Electron IPC, no OS-level notification integration per explore agent report). Cline's #13166 adds native OS notifications for task completion — immediate awareness when agent finishes long-running work (no need to watch terminal), desktop notification center integration. MODERATE priority: quality-of-life improvement (valuable for long-running agent tasks, CLI users often switch away from terminal), medium complexity (~6h: add CLI-friendly notification abstraction via node-notifier or terminal-notifier, permission gating, Ink context integration for notification triggers, task-completion hook, test across macOS/Linux/Windows). Pattern portable (node-notifier works for Node CLI apps, permission gating reuses existing permission system).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13166 "feat(desktop): native notifications" (merged 2026-08-19). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13166. Adds macOS target, desktop app identity isolation.
- **Category**: tools/config (native notifications). **Size**: ~6h (add node-notifier or terminal-notifier, permission gating, Ink context integration, task-completion hook, test across OS). **Priority**: MODERATE (quality-of-life improvement, medium complexity, CLI users benefit from desktop notifications). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-19).
